description: This bar chart illustrates the Average Performance across three different categories. The horizontal category axis displays three labels ordered from left to right: "Base", "CORG", and "AdaCAD", without an overall axis title. The vertical value axis is labeled "Average Performance" and features a linear scale that begins at a truncated baseline of 48 and ranges up to 62, with numeric tick labels regularly spaced at intervals of 2 units. Horizontal dashed grid lines extend across the plot area corresponding to each vertical tick mark. The chart utilizes a stacked bar format, with an upper-left legend indicating that grey represents "Standard" and blue represents "Ours". Visually, the grey segments form the bottom portions of the bars starting from the 48 baseline, while the blue segments are stacked directly on top of them. The first category, "Base", is represented by a single solid blue bar extending to approximately 59.2, lacking a visible grey segment. The "CORG" category features a bottom grey segment reaching roughly 51.5 and a top blue segment bringing the overall bar height to approximately 59.5. The "AdaCAD" category displays the tallest combined bar, with its bottom grey segment reaching about 53.4 and its top blue segment extending to a peak value of roughly 60.2. The bars are not sorted in a specific alphabetical or descending order, and there are no visually emphasized bars, outlines, or additional annotations present in the chart.
